annotations.title: Add a product to a named list

description: Adds a product (by slug) to one of the signed-in person's lists with an optional private note; the product's total for `deliver_to_country` today is kept as saved_total (for "the price changed since you saved it"). Adding it again only changes the note. At most 200 products per list. Another person's list answers not_found.

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

note.description: A private note to the product (at most 280 characters); never shown on the share link.

name: add_to_list
title: Add a product to a named list
